page.layout: One printed page. Running head at top, page number at top left. Left margin holds notes beside the text column (in the middle-left, between the verse column and the left edge of the text block). Main text: one column of italic verse lines running from top to bottom on the right-centre; notes are placed in a narrow column to its left.

main_text.l: Sub his floribus apparata mensa est,
Et iam Sol medium secabat axem
main_text.p: *Tales scilicet erat olim filij Prophetarum (quos vocat Scriptura) id est di scipuli, tempore Eliæ & Elisæi.

*Sic Dominus fatigatus ex itinere sedit ad fonte oppidi Samariæ hora quasi sexta, sitiens & expectans, dum discipuli emptos ex urbe cibos afferant. Sic Paulus post longam in mari iactationem, totus etiam ex naufragio madens, humaniter excipitur à Barbaris Melitensibus, & iniectis in pyram accensam sarmentis seipsum calefacit.
*Apoc. c. 18 v. 16. Ciuitas illa magna quæ amicta erat bysso & purpura & cocco, & deaurata erat auro & lapidibus pretiosis & margaritis.
Notatu dignissimum, quòd conuiuium exordiatur Cardinalis nulla coepta ad Deum precatione.

page.notes: Left-margin notes are set beside the verse column in the printed page; the exact placement of the star marks in the verse lines (at "Ætate", "Gemmis", "Diuam" area) is approximate. Some words in the verse are doubtful (e.g. "beaaret", "Distincto variys", "pictlo", "sydereis", "amicta", "bysso") and should be checked against the scan. Show-through text from the reverse page is ignored.
